scenarios.expected: Applying a group snapshots members into Approval requests; later group edits do not rewrite those requests. Non-Member+ selections and unauthorized configuration are refused; existing requests retain their recorded identities.
scenarios.actual: 13 recorded steps passed on 3fa407e3. Nadia Haddad was redirected from Approver groups and the group API answered 403. The profile menu, Settings, Contracts, Approver groups path opened the pane. Add group offered 13 people and none of the 16 Business Users; after Add group and reload, Edit showed both chosen members. Adding a Business User through the member-list save was refused with 422 naming the person, and the group kept 2 members. On a Contract, Approvals then Approvals & signing offered Apply group; the dialog named both people and warned that later group edits leave the requests as they are, and applying created 2 Pending requests stamped with the group. Applying again showed "Everybody in this group already has a request open." and was refused. With one member already asked, the dialog said "Skips 1 person who already has a request open." and only the other request was added. With a member changed to Business user, the whole apply was refused by name and created nothing, and the editor marked that member "Can no longer approve"; after the role was restored the apply created both requests. On a Confidential Contract a member outside the audience refused the whole apply by name with no requests. A group with no members was refused with "... has no members to ask." Editing the members, Archive group (whose confirmation asked for no replacement), hiding from the apply picker while archived, and Show archived then Restore all left the first Contract's two requests and named people unchanged. Nadia Haddad applied the group on a Contract she could open and got 2 Pending requests.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
The picker offers no Business User, so the non-Member+ refusal was checked on the member-list save that the editor uses, not through a picker click.
Decisions, cancellation and the Approval Stage belong to contract-approvals and were not replayed.
The audit log entry for configuration changes was not opened.
